def draw(self, screen, camera):
    center = np.array([self.x, self.y])

    color = tuple(self.colors["robot"])
    outline = tuple(self.colors["black"])

    # =====================================
    # Geometria do casco
    # =====================================

    W = 0.9 * self.radius
    L = math.sqrt(4*self.radius**2 - W**2)

    hull_local = np.array([
        [-0.50 * L, -0.50 * W],
        [ 0.25 * L, -0.50 * W],
        [ 0.50 * L,  0.00 * W],
        [ 0.25 * L,  0.50 * W],
        [-0.50 * L,  0.50 * W],
    ])

    bow_local = np.array([
        [ 0.50 * L, 0.0],
        [ 0.20 * L, -0.25 * W],
        [ 0.20 * L,  0.25 * W],
    ])

    # =====================================
    # Rotação
    # =====================================

    c = math.cos(self.theta)
    s = math.sin(self.theta)

    R = np.array([
        [c, -s],
        [s,  c]
    ])

    hull_world = (R @ hull_local.T).T + center
    bow_world = (R @ bow_local.T).T + center

    hull_screen = [
        camera.world_to_screen(*p)
        for p in hull_world
    ]

    bow_screen = [
        camera.world_to_screen(*p)
        for p in bow_world
    ]

    # =====================================
    # Desenho
    # =====================================

    pygame.draw.polygon(
        screen,
        color,
        hull_screen
    )

    pygame.draw.polygon(
        screen,
        color,
        bow_screen
    )

    pygame.draw.polygon(
        screen,
        outline,
        hull_screen,
        2
    )

    # =========================
    # Círculo transparente
    # =========================
    radius_px = max(5, int(self.radius * camera.scale))

    circle_surface = pygame.Surface(
        (radius_px * 2, radius_px * 2),
        pygame.SRCALPHA
    )

    color = (*self.colors["robot"], 120)

    pygame.draw.circle(
        circle_surface,
        color,
        (radius_px, radius_px),
        radius_px
    )
    screen_pos = camera.world_to_screen(self.x, self.y)

    screen.blit(
        circle_surface,
        (screen_pos[0] - radius_px,
        screen_pos[1] - radius_px)
    )

    # linha central (opcional)

    front = center + np.array([
        math.cos(self.theta),
        math.sin(self.theta)
    ]) * L * 0.6

    pygame.draw.line(
        screen,
        tuple(self.colors["white"]),
        camera.world_to_screen(*center),
        camera.world_to_screen(*front),
        2
    )

def __init__(self, config: dict = None, controller=None, draw_callback=None, type_robot=None, fleet_controller=None):
    # pygame.init()
    pygame.display.init()
    pygame.font.init()

    # -----------------------------------------------------------
    # FALLBACK PARA DEFAULT CONFIG
    # -----------------------------------------------------------
    if config is None:
        print("Carregando configuração padrão.")
        self.config = deepcopy(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
        config = self.config
    else:
        self.config = config

    # Aplicar tema
    theme_name = str(self.config.get("theme", "dark"))
    self.apply_theme(theme_name)

    if type_robot is not None:
        self.config["robot"]["type"] = type_robot
        config["robot"]["type"] = type_robot
    w = int(self.config["window"]["width"]); h = int(self.config["window"]["height"])
    self.min_width = int(self.config["window"].get("min_width", 1000))
    self.min_height = int(self.config["window"].get("min_height", 650))
    self.panel_width = int(self.config["window"].get("panel_width", 300))
    self.colors = self.config["colors"]
    self.width, self.height = w, h
    self.world_view_width = max(400, self.width - self.panel_width)
    self.panel_x = self.world_view_width
    self.screen = pygame.display.set_mode((self.width, self.height), pygame.RESIZABLE)
    pygame.display.set_caption(self.config["window"].get("title", "NavSim"))

    icon = _render_honeybee_icon()
    if icon is not None:
        pygame.display.set_icon(icon)

    self.clock = pygame.time.Clock()
    self.manager = pygame_gui.UIManager((self.width, self.height))
    self.world = World(self.config)
    self.grid_map = self.world.grid_map
    self.explosion_img = pygame.image.load(
        assets_dir / "explosion.png"
    ).convert_alpha()

    self.camera = Camera2D(
        self.world.width,
        self.world.height,
        self.world_view_width,
        self.height,
        **self.config["camera"]
    )



    self.robots = create_fleet(self.config)
    self.num_robots = len(self.robots)

    self.track_editor = TrackEditor(self.world, self.config)

    self.lidar = Lidar(self.config)

    self.robot_lidar_readings = [[] for _ in range(self.num_robots)]
    self.collisions = [False] * self.num_robots

    # Histórico de colisões (robô-robô, obstáculo ou grid) para o logger.
    self.sim_time = 0.0
    self.collision_events: list[dict] = []
    self._active_collision_keys: set = set()

    # Último comando cru emitido pelo controller (sem ruído), por robô.

    self.last_commands = [{} for _ in range(self.num_robots)]

    self.map_file_dialog = None
    self.pending_map_path = None
    self.resolution_window = None
    self.resolution_entry = None

    self.gui = GUI(self.screen, self.manager, self._layout())
    self.running = True
    self.running_simulation = self.config.get("running_simulation", False)
    self.dt = 0.03
    self.dragging = False
    self.last_mouse_pos = None
    self.pending_obstacle_position = None

def set_themes(self, new_themes: dict):
    """
    Permite definir dinamicamente os temas do simulador.

    global THEMES

    # Re-aplica o tema atual para garantir que as cores sejam atualizadas
    current_theme = self.config.get("theme", "dark")
    self.apply_theme(current_theme)

def load_scene_from_config(self):
    # -----------------------------
    # Obstáculos
    # -----------------------------

    self.world.obstacles.clear()

    for obs in self.config.get("obstacles", []):
        self.world.add_obstacle((obs["x"], obs["y"]), obs["radius"] )

    # -----------------------------
    # Waypoints
    # -----------------------------

    for manager in self.waypoint_managers:
        manager.clear()

    for index, robot_cfg in enumerate(self.config.get("robots", [])):
        if index >= self.num_robots:
            break
        for wp in robot_cfg.get("waypoints", []):
            self.waypoint_managers[index].add_waypoint(wp)

    for wp in self.config.get("waypoints", {}).get("points", []):
        self.waypoint_managers[0].add_waypoint(wp)

def apply_track(self):
    if self.track_editor is None:
        return
    path = self.config.get("world", {}).get(
        "drawn_line_map_image", "config/line_drawn.png"
    )
    line_map = self.track_editor.apply(path)
    self.config.setdefault("world", {})["line_map_image"] = path

    pose = self.track_editor.start_pose
    if pose is not None:
        x, y, theta = pose
        for robot in self.robots:
            if hasattr(robot, "set_initial_pose"):
                robot.set_initial_pose(x, y, theta)

    print(
        f"[TrackEditor] Pista aplicada ({line_map.width_m:.2f}x"
        f"{line_map.height_m:.2f} m, res={line_map.resolution}). Salva em '{path}'."
    )
    if pose is not None:
        print(f"[TrackEditor] Robo posicionado em ({x:.2f}, {y:.2f}).")
    else:
        print("[TrackEditor] Dica: desenhe uma linha antes de aplicar.")

def save_config(self, path="config/default.yaml"):

    cfg = deepcopy(self.config)

    # ---------------------------------
    # Obstáculos
    # ---------------------------------

    cfg["obstacles"] = []

    for obs in self.world.obstacles:

        cfg["obstacles"].append({
            "x": float(obs[0]),
            "y": float(obs[1]),
            "radius": float(obs[2])
        })

    # ---------------------------------
    # Waypoints (per robot)
    # ---------------------------------
    cfg.setdefault("robots", [])
    for index, manager in enumerate(self.waypoint_managers):
        robot_cfg = cfg["robots"][index] if index < len(cfg["robots"]) else {}
        robot_cfg["waypoints"] = [
            [float(v) for v in wp]
            for wp in manager.waypoints
        ]
        if index >= len(cfg["robots"]):
            cfg["robots"].append(robot_cfg)

    cfg.setdefault("waypoints", {})
    cfg["waypoints"]["points"] = [
        [float(v) for v in wp]
        for wp in self.waypoint_managers[0].waypoints
    ]

    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        yaml.dump(
            cfg,
            f,
            sort_keys=False,
            allow_unicode=True
        )

    print(f"Config saved to {path}")

def handle_button_event(self, event):
    if event.type != pygame_gui.UI_BUTTON_PRESSED:
        return

    # Botões da janela/modal de raio do obstáculo
    if event.ui_element == self.gui.obstacle_radius_ok:
        self.confirm_obstacle_radius()
        return

    if event.ui_element == self.gui.obstacle_radius_cancel:
        self.pending_obstacle_position = None
        self.gui.close_obstacle_radius_window()
        return

    e = self.gui.elements

    if "start" in e and event.ui_element == e["start"]:
        self.running_simulation = not self.running_simulation

    elif "reset" in e and event.ui_element == e["reset"]:
        self.running_simulation = False
        self.reset()

    elif "clear_path" in e and event.ui_element == e["clear_path"]:
        for robot in self.robots:
            robot.clear_path()

    elif "clear_waypoints" in e and event.ui_element == e["clear_waypoints"]:
        for manager in self.waypoint_managers:
            manager.clear()

    elif "clear_obstacles" in e and event.ui_element == e["clear_obstacles"]:
        self.world.clear_obstacles()

    elif "draw_track" in e and event.ui_element == e["draw_track"]:
        self.toggle_track_editor()

    elif "apply_track" in e and event.ui_element == e["apply_track"]:
        self.apply_track()

    elif "clear_track" in e and event.ui_element == e["clear_track"]:
        self.clear_track()

    elif "toggle_theme" in e and event.ui_element == e["toggle_theme"]:
        self.toggle_theme()

    elif "load_map" in e and event.ui_element == e["load_map"]:
        self.map_file_dialog = pygame_gui.windows.UIFileDialog(
            rect=pygame.Rect(160, 50, 600, 500),
            manager=self.manager,
            window_title="Load Map",
            allow_existing_files_only=True,
            allowed_suffixes={".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg"}
        )

    elif "toggle_lidar" in e and event.ui_element == e["toggle_lidar"]:
        self.lidar.enabled = not self.lidar.enabled

    elif "toggle_noise" in e and event.ui_element == e["toggle_noise"]:
        noise = self.config.setdefault("noise", {})
        noise["enabled"] = not noise.get("enabled", False)
        state = "enabled" if noise["enabled"] else "disabled"
        print(f"[Simulator] Gaussian velocity noise {state} "
              f"(sigma_v={noise.get('sigma_v', 0.0)}, "
              f"sigma_omega={noise.get('sigma_omega', 0.0)}, "
              f"limit={noise.get('limit', 3.0)}).")

    elif "toggle_times" in e and event.ui_element == e["toggle_times"]:
        show = not self.config.get("show_times", True)
        self.config["show_times"] = show
        state = "ativada" if show else "desativada"
        print(f"[Simulator] Visualizacao de tempos (line follower) {state}.")

    elif "save_config" in e and event.ui_element == e["save_config"]:
        self.save_config()

    elif "center_camera" in e and event.ui_element == e["center_camera"]:
        self.camera.center_on_origin_with_margin()

    elif "plot_log" in e and event.ui_element == e["plot_log"]:
        self.logger.plot()

    elif "reset_logger" in e and event.ui_element == e["reset_logger"]:
        self.logger.reset()

    elif "export_log" in e and event.ui_element == e["export_log"]:
        # self.gui.process_file_dialog_event(event, self.logger)

        self.gui.export_log(self.logger)

def confirm_obstacle_radius(self):
    if self.pending_obstacle_position is None:
        self.gui.close_obstacle_radius_window()
        return

    try:
        radius_text = self.gui.obstacle_radius_entry.get_text()
        radius = float(radius_text)

        if radius <= 0:
            print("Raio inválido. O raio deve ser maior que zero.")
            return

    except ValueError:
        print("Raio inválido. Digite um número, por exemplo: 0.4")
        return

    self.world.add_obstacle(
        self.pending_obstacle_position,
        radius=radius
    )
    self.config["world"]["obstacles"] = np.array(self.world.obstacles).tolist()

    self.pending_obstacle_position = None
    self.gui.close_obstacle_radius_window()

def check_collision(self, robot=None):
    robot = self.robot if robot is None else robot
    q = robot.position
    r_robot = robot.radius   

    if self.world.grid_map is not None:
        # Alterado para False para que a colisão ocorra de forma mais precisa/profunda
        if self.world.grid_map.is_occupied(q[0], q[1], use_inflated=True):
            return True

    for obs in self.world.obstacles:
        center = self.world.get_position(obs)
        r_obs = self.world.obstacle_radius(obs)

        dist = np.linalg.norm(q - center)

        if dist < (r_obs + r_robot):
            return True

    return False

def robot_collision_enabled(self) -> bool:
    """True se a colisão entre robôs deve ser avaliada."""
    policies = self.config.get("interaction", {})
    if not bool(policies.get("robot_collision", True)):
        return False
    policy = str(policies.get("collision_policy", "stop")).lower()
    return policy not in ("none", "off", "ignore")

def process_events(self):
    for event in pygame.event.get():

        # ==================================================
        # EVENTOS BÁSICOS DA JANELA
        # ==================================================

        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            self.running = False

        elif event.type == pygame.VIDEORESIZE:
            self.resize(event.w, event.h)

        elif event.type == pygame.KEYDOWN:
            if pygame.K_1 <= event.key <= pygame.K_9:
                index = event.key - pygame.K_1
                if index < self.num_robots:
                    self.select_robot(index)

        # ==================================================
        # PRIMEIRO: ENTREGAR EVENTOS PARA A GUI
        # ==================================================
        # Isso garante que botões, caixas de texto e janelas
        # recebam o clique antes do mundo.

        self.manager.process_events(event)

        if (event.type == pygame_gui.UI_FILE_DIALOG_PATH_PICKED and
            self.map_file_dialog is not None and
            event.ui_element == self.map_file_dialog):

            self.pending_map_path = event.text
            self.open_resolution_window()

            self.map_file_dialog.kill()
            self.map_file_dialog = None

        if (event.type == pygame_gui.UI_BUTTON_PRESSED and
            self.resolution_window is not None and
            event.ui_element == self.resolution_ok_button):

            try:
                res = float(self.resolution_entry.get_text())
                self.world.load_map(self.pending_map_path, res)
                self.grid_map = self.world.grid_map
                print(f"Mapa carregado: {self.pending_map_path} com res {res}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"Erro ao carregar mapa: {e}")

            self.resolution_window.kill()
            self.resolution_window = None
            self.pending_map_path = None

        self.handle_button_event(event)

        self.gui.process_slider_event(
            event,
            self.robots,
            self.world,
            self.lidar,
            self.config
        )

        # ==================================================
        # ENTER NA CAIXA DE RAIO DO OBSTÁCULO
        # ==================================================

        if event.type == pygame_gui.UI_TEXT_ENTRY_FINISHED:

            if event.ui_element == self.gui.obstacle_radius_entry:
                self.confirm_obstacle_radius()
                continue

            elif event.ui_element == self.gui.orientation_entry:
                self.confirm_waypoint_orientation()
                continue

        # ==================================================
        # SE MODAL ESTIVER ABERTA, O MUNDO NÃO RECEBE EVENTO
        # ==================================================
        # Isso evita que clicar no OK vire waypoint.

        if self.is_modal_open():
            continue

        # ==================================================
        # SE O MOUSE ESTIVER SOBRE ALGUM ELEMENTO DA GUI,
        # O MUNDO TAMBÉM NÃO RECEBE EVENTO
        # ==================================================

        if self.manager.get_hovering_any_element():
            continue

        # ==================================================
        # MODO DE DESENHO DA PISTA (LINE FOLLOWER)
        # ==================================================
        if (
            self.track_editor is not None
            and self.track_editor.active
            and self.mouse_inside_world(pygame.mouse.get_pos())
        ):
            if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN and event.button == 1:
                pos = self.camera.screen_to_world(*event.pos)
                self.track_editor.begin(pos[0], pos[1])
                continue

            if event.type == pygame.MOUSEMOTION and self.track_editor.drawing:
                pos = self.camera.screen_to_world(*event.pos)
                self.track_editor.extend(pos[0], pos[1])
                continue

            if event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONUP and event.button == 1:
                self.track_editor.end()
                continue

        # ==================================================
        # EVENTOS DO MUNDO
        # ==================================================

        if event.type == pygame.MOUSEWHEEL:
            mouse_pos = pygame.mouse.get_pos()

            if self.mouse_inside_world(mouse_pos):
                self.camera.zoom_at(mouse_pos, event.y)

        elif event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONDOWN:

            # Botão do meio: pan
            if event.button == 2 and self.mouse_inside_world(event.pos):
                self.dragging = True
                self.last_mouse_pos = event.pos

            # Botão esquerdo: waypoint
            elif event.button == 1 and self.mouse_inside_world(event.pos):
                pos = self.camera.screen_to_world(*event.pos)

                # define_orientation = self.config["waypoints"].get(
                #     "define_orientation",
                #     False
                # )                    

                if self.waypoints.define_orientation:                        

                    self.pending_waypoint_position = pos

                    self.gui.open_waypoint_orientation_window(
                        default_angle=0.0
                    )

                else:

                    self.waypoints.add_waypoint(pos)

            # Botão direito: abre janela para raio do obstáculo ou arrasta (com Shift)
            elif event.button == 3 and self.mouse_inside_world(event.pos):
                mods = pygame.key.get_mods()
                if mods & pygame.KMOD_SHIFT:
                    self.dragging = True
                    self.last_mouse_pos = event.pos
                else:
                    self.pending_obstacle_position = self.camera.screen_to_world(
                        *event.pos
                    )

                    self.gui.open_obstacle_radius_window(
                        default_radius=self.world.default_obstacle_radius
                    )

        elif event.type == pygame.MOUSEBUTTONUP:
            self.dragging = False

        elif event.type == pygame.MOUSEMOTION and self.dragging:
            dx = event.pos[0] - self.last_mouse_pos[0]
            dy = event.pos[1] - self.last_mouse_pos[1]

            self.camera.pan_pixels(dx, dy)

            self.last_mouse_pos = event.pos

def update_simulation(self):
    if not self.running_simulation:
        return

    policies = self.config.get("interaction", {})
    safety_margin = float(policies.get("robot_safety_margin", 0.0))
    collision_policy = str(policies.get("collision_policy", "stop")).lower()
    evaluate_robot_collision = self.robot_collision_enabled()

    self.sim_time += self.dt
    current_collision_keys: set = set()

    # ======================================================
    # Recarga (por robô)
    # ======================================================
    active = [True] * self.num_robots
    for index, robot in enumerate(self.robots):
        if not getattr(robot, "is_charging", False):
            continue
        for rp in self.world.recharge_places:
            pos_rp = self.world.get_position(rp)
            tolerance = self.waypoint_managers[index].goal_tolerance
            if np.linalg.norm(robot.position - pos_rp) <= tolerance:
                robot.going_to_recharge = False
                if hasattr(robot, "update_battery"):
                    robot.update_battery(self.dt, charge_rate=20.0)
                if robot.battery_percent >= getattr(robot, "working_battery", 90.0):
                    robot.is_charging = False
                active[index] = False
                break

    # ======================================================
    # Waypoints e LiDAR (por robô)
    # ======================================================
    # Quando a colisão robô-robô está ativa, os demais B-bots são
    # considerados obstáculos móveis no LiDAR.
    lidar_robots = self.lidar_obstacle_robots()
    goals = []
    for index, robot in enumerate(self.robots):
        self.waypoint_managers[index].update(robot.position)
        goals.append(self.waypoint_managers[index].get_current_waypoint())
        self.robot_lidar_readings[index] = self.lidar.cast_rays(
            robot, self.world, lidar_robots
        )

    # ======================================================
    # Comandos a partir de um snapshot congelado da frota
    # ======================================================
    commands = self._compute_commands(goals)

    # Guarda o comando cru (sem ruído) para o logger e aplica o ruído
    # gaussiano de atuação antes de integrar a cinemática.
    self.last_commands = commands
    commands = self._apply_noise(commands)

    # ======================================================
    # Integração simultânea (independente de ordem)
    # ======================================================
    for index, robot in enumerate(self.robots):
        if self.collisions[index] or not active[index]:
            continue
        robot.step(commands[index], self.dt)

    # ======================================================
    # Colisão estática (por robô)
    # ======================================================
    for index, robot in enumerate(self.robots):
        if self.collisions[index]:
            continue
        source = self._static_collision_source(robot, index)
        if source is not None:
            key, event = source
            self.collisions[index] = True
            current_collision_keys.add(key)
            self._emit_collision(key, event)

    # ======================================================
    # Interação robô-robô
    # ======================================================
    # ``robot_collision: false`` (ou ``collision_policy: none``) desliga
    # completamente a avaliação de colisão entre os robôs - útil, por
    # exemplo, para várias instâncias de line follower iniciando no mesmo
    # ponto da pista.
    if self.num_robots > 1 and evaluate_robot_collision:
        pairs = interaction.detect_robot_collisions(self.robots, safety_margin)
        if pairs:
            if collision_policy == "stop":
                for i, j, _ in pairs:
                    self.collisions[i] = True
                    self.collisions[j] = True
            elif collision_policy == "resolve":
                interaction.resolve_robot_overlaps(
                    self.robots,
                    safety_margin,
                    float(policies.get("resolve_push", 0.05)),
                )
            for i, j, distance in pairs:
                key = ("robot", min(i, j), max(i, j))
                current_collision_keys.add(key)
                self._emit_collision(
                    key,
                    {
                        "kind": "robot",
                        "robots": [int(i), int(j)],
                        "distance": float(distance),
                    },
                )

    self._active_collision_keys = current_collision_keys

def go_to_recharge_place(self, id, angle=0.0, robot_index=None):
    index = self.selected_robot_index if robot_index is None else int(robot_index)
    pos = self.world.get_recharge_place(id)
    robot = self.robots[index]
    robot.going_to_recharge = True

    if pos is not None:
        waypoint = [pos[0], pos[1], angle]
        # Adiciona como o objetivo ATUAL (o robô irá para lá agora)
        self.waypoint_managers[index].insert_waypoint_at_current(waypoint)
        # Como inserimos na posição atual, o waypoint que era o atual
        # foi empurrado para a próxima posição. 
        # Não precisamos incrementar o índice.
        print(f"Robô {index} enviado para o ponto de recarga {id}: {waypoint}")
    else:
        print(f"Ponto de recarga {id} não encontrado.")

def draw(self, fps):
    c = self.config["colors"]
    self.screen.fill(tuple(c["background"]))

    # Desenha o mapa do mundo
    if self.grid_map is not None:
        # Desenhamos o mapa (se grid_map existir, ele substitui o grid padrão)
        self.world.draw_grid(self.screen, self.camera)
        self.grid_map.draw(self.screen, self.camera, draw_inflated=False)
        if self.world.show_inflation:
            self.grid_map.draw(self.screen, self.camera, draw_inflated=True)

    else:
        self.world.draw_line_map(self.screen, self.camera)
        self.world.draw_grid(self.screen, self.camera)

    if self.track_editor is not None and self.track_editor.active:
        self.track_editor.draw(self.screen, self.camera)

    self.world.draw_origin(self.screen, self.camera)
    self.world.draw_axes(self.screen, self.camera)
    pygame.draw.rect(self.screen, tuple(c["panel"]), (self.panel_x, 0, self.panel_width, self.height))
    pygame.draw.line(self.screen, tuple(c["white"]), (self.world_view_width, 0), (self.world_view_width, self.height), 2)

    self._draw_robot_links()

    for index, robot in enumerate(self.robots):
        robot.draw_path(self.screen, self.camera)
    self.world.draw_obstacles(self.screen, self.camera)
    self.world.draw_recharge_places(self.screen, self.camera)
    for manager in self.waypoint_managers:
        manager.draw(self.screen, self.camera)
    lidar_robots = self.lidar_obstacle_robots()
    for index, robot in enumerate(self.robots):
        self.lidar.draw(self.screen, self.camera, robot, self.world, lidar_robots)
    for index, robot in enumerate(self.robots):
        robot.draw(self.screen, self.camera)
        if self.collisions[index]:
            self._draw_explosion(robot)

    self.gui.update_info(
        self.robots,
        self.waypoint_managers,
        self.world,
        fps,
        self.running_simulation,
        self.lidar,
        self.camera,
        selected=self.selected_robot_index,
        collisions=self.collisions,
        config=self.config,
    )
    self.manager.draw_ui(self.screen)

    if self.track_editor is not None and self.track_editor.active:
        self.track_editor.draw_cursor_hint(self.screen)


    # ==================================================
    # DESENHO CUSTOMIZADO
    # ==================================================        
    if hasattr(self, "draw_callback") and self.draw_callback is not None:
        self.draw_callback(self, self.screen)

    self.logger.draw_callback(self, self.screen)
    pygame.display.flip()

def step(self):
    time_delta = self.clock.tick(60) / 1000.0
    fps = self.clock.get_fps()

    self.cleanup_closed_windows()

    self.process_events()

def get_planning_signature(sim):

    obstacles_sig = tuple(
        (
            round(obs[0], 2),
            round(obs[1], 2),
            round(obs[2], 2),
        )
        for obs in sim.world.obstacles

            round(wp[1], 2)
        )
        for wp in sim.waypoints.waypoints
    )

    return (
        obstacles_sig,
        waypoints_sig
    )

def set_map_from_grid(self, grid, resolution, name="generated_map.png"):

    self.config["world"]["resolution"] = resolution

def draw(self, screen, camera):
    if not self.waypoints:
        return
    waypoint_color = tuple(self.colors["waypoint"])
    goal_color = tuple(self.colors["goal"])
    black = tuple(self.colors["black"])
    # for i in range(len(self.waypoints) - 1):
    #     pygame.draw.line(screen, waypoint_color, camera.world_to_screen(*self.waypoints[i]), camera.world_to_screen(*self.waypoints[i+1]), 2)
    for i, wp in enumerate(self.waypoints):
        color = goal_color if i == self.current_index else waypoint_color
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, color, camera.world_to_screen(*wp[:2]), 8)
        pygame.draw.circle(screen, black, camera.world_to_screen(*wp[:2]), 8, 2)


        # =========================
        # Círculo transparente
        # =========================
        if self.show_tolerance_circle:
            radius_px = max(5, int(self.goal_tolerance * camera.scale))

            circle_surface = pygame.Surface(
                (radius_px * 2, radius_px * 2),
                pygame.SRCALPHA
            )

            color2 = (*color, 120)

            pygame.draw.circle(
                circle_surface,
                color2,
                (radius_px, radius_px),
                radius_px
            )

            screen_pos = camera.world_to_screen(*wp[:2])

            screen.blit(
                circle_surface,
                (screen_pos[0] - radius_px,
                screen_pos[1] - radius_px)
            )

        theta = wp[2]
        if not np.isnan(theta):

            px, py = camera.world_to_screen(wp[0], wp[1])

            arrow_len = max(20, int(0.5 * camera.scale))

            tip_x = px + arrow_len * np.cos(theta)
            tip_y = py - arrow_len * np.sin(theta)

            pygame.draw.line(
                screen,
                black,
                (px, py),
                (tip_x, tip_y),
                3
            )

            head_size = 8

            pygame.draw.line(
                screen,
                black,
                (tip_x, tip_y),
                (
                    tip_x - head_size*np.cos(theta - np.pi/6),
                    tip_y + head_size*np.sin(theta - np.pi/6)
                ),
                3
            )

            pygame.draw.line(
                screen,
                black,
                (tip_x, tip_y),
                (
                    tip_x - head_size*np.cos(theta + np.pi/6),
                    tip_y + head_size*np.sin(theta + np.pi/6)
                ),
                3
            )

def distance_to_nearest_obstacle(self, position):
    if not self.obstacles:
        return float("inf")

    distances = []

    for obs in self.obstacles:
        center = self.get_position(obs)
        radius = self.obstacle_radius(obs)

        distance = np.linalg.norm(position - center) - radius
        distances.append(distance)

    return float(min(distances))

def draw_grid(self, screen, camera):
    step_px = self.grid_size * camera.scale

    if step_px < 8:
        return

    bottom_left = camera.screen_to_world(
        0,
        camera.viewport_height
    )

    top_right = camera.screen_to_world(
        camera.viewport_width,
        0
    )

    min_x, min_y = bottom_left
    max_x, max_y = top_right

    start_x = math.floor(min_x / self.grid_size) * self.grid_size
    end_x = math.ceil(max_x / self.grid_size) * self.grid_size

    start_y = math.floor(min_y / self.grid_size) * self.grid_size
    end_y = math.ceil(max_y / self.grid_size) * self.grid_size

    color = tuple(self.colors["grid"])

    x = start_x
    while x <= end_x:
        pygame.draw.line(
            screen,
            color,
            camera.world_to_screen(x, min_y),
            camera.world_to_screen(x, max_y)
        )

        x += self.grid_size

    y = start_y
    while y <= end_y:
        pygame.draw.line(
            screen,
            color,
            camera.world_to_screen(min_x, y),
            camera.world_to_screen(max_x, y)
        )

        y += self.grid_size

Reference: examples/decentralized_swarm.py

A heterogeneous fleet of HiveBrAgents. Each B-bot runs its own instance of the same agent class (with per-robot parameters), sees only its own state plus its neighbors, and reads its waypoint from state.goal.

docs.title: What it shows
docs.text:
• The decentralized paradigm: HiveBrAgent.loop(state, neighbors).
  • SwarmExperiment.assign_agent for homogeneous and heterogeneous fleets.
  • SwarmExperiment.assign_route to give each B-bot its route.
  • A local separation term computed from the visible neighbors.
  • Communication radius (comm_radius) shaping who sees whom.
  • The backend seam: change backend="ros2" to target the physical arena.

class PatrolAgent(HiveBrAgent):

        self.sep_gain = self.params.get("sep_gain", 0.0)

        goal = state.goal
        if goal is None:
            return (0.0, 0.0)
        # Kanayama control using state.x, state.y, state.theta, goal
        # plus a reactive separation term over `neighbors`

exp = SwarmExperiment(robots=fleet, backend="navsim2d", config=config,
                      orientation=True, goal_tolerance=0.2)
exp.assign_agent(robot_id=0, agent_class=PatrolAgent, sep_gain=0.5, kp=0.45)
exp.assign_agent(robot_ids=[1, 2, 3], agent_class=PatrolAgent, sep_gain=0.9)

docs.title: Full source
docs.text:
examples/decentralized_swarm.py
"""Decentralized swarm navigation using the hivebr OpenLab API.

Each B-bot is an independent ``HiveBrAgent`` instance and only sees its own
state plus its neighbors. The current waypoint arrives inside
``state.goal`` (``(x, y)`` or ``(x, y, theta)``), filled by the engine and
carried through the bridge.

The same script can later be pointed at the physical arena with
``backend="ros2"`` without touching the agent code.

Controls:
    Keys 1..N  -> select B-bot | Left click -> add waypoint | Right click -> obstacle
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

project_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.append(str(project_root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root / "src"))

from hivebr import HiveBrAgent, SwarmExperiment
from hivebr.engine import load_config


def wrap(angle):
    return float((angle + np.pi) % (2.0 * np.pi) - np.pi)


class PatrolAgent(HiveBrAgent):
    """Decentralized Kanayama controller with local separation."""

    def setup(self):
        self.kp = self.params.get("kp", 0.35)
        self.k_alpha = self.params.get("k_alpha", 1.5)
        self.k_beta = self.params.get("k_beta", -1.0)
        # Goal tolerance straight from the engine config (YAML file), with an
        # explicit r_tol parameter and a default as fallbacks.
        self.r_tol = float(
            (self.cfg or {}).get("waypoints", {}).get(
                "goal_tolerance", self.params.get("r_tol", 0.2)
            )
        )
        self.sep_gain = self.params.get("sep_gain", 0.0)
        self.sep_steer = self.params.get("sep_steer", 1.2)
        self.sep_margin = self.params.get("sep_margin", 0.35)

    def loop(self, state, neighbors):
        goal = state.goal
        if goal is None:
            return (0.0, 0.0)

        theta_d = goal[2] if len(goal) > 2 else state.theta
        dx = goal[0] - state.x
        dy = goal[1] - state.y
        rho = float(np.hypot(dx, dy))
        if rho < self.r_tol:
            return (0.0, 0.0)

        alpha = wrap(np.arctan2(dy, dx) - state.theta)
        beta = wrap(theta_d - state.theta - alpha)

        kp = self.kp
        if abs(alpha) > np.pi / 2:
            alpha = wrap(alpha - np.pi)
            beta = wrap(beta - np.pi)
            kp = -kp

        v = kp * rho
        w = self.k_beta * beta + self.k_alpha * alpha

        # Local reactive separation from surrounding B-bots. Only neighbors that
        # are *ahead* brake the forward speed; braking on every neighbor makes
        # two B-bots whose paths cross cancel each other's speed and deadlock. A
        # small steering term biases the heading away so they go around instead.
        for neighbor in neighbors.values():
            d = float(np.hypot(state.x - neighbor.x, state.y - neighbor.y))
            safe = state.radius + neighbor.radius + self.sep_margin
            if 0.0 < d < safe:
                shortfall = safe - d
                bearing = wrap(
                    np.arctan2(neighbor.y - state.y, neighbor.x - state.x)
                    - state.theta
                )
                v -= self.sep_gain * shortfall * max(0.0, np.cos(bearing))
                w -= self.sep_steer * shortfall * np.sin(bearing)

        return (v, w)


def route_with_orientation(points):
    waypoints = []
    for p, p_next in zip(points, points[1:] + [points[0]]):
        theta = float(np.arctan2(p_next[1] - p[1], p_next[0] - p[0]))
        waypoints.append([p[0], p[1], theta])
    return waypoints


if __name__ == "__main__":
    config = load_config(project_root / "config" / "default.yaml")
    config["interaction"] = {
        "collision_policy": "resolve",
        "robot_collision": True,
        "robot_safety_margin": 0.0,
        "resolve_push": 0.05,
        "comm_radius": 3.0,
        "show_robot_links": True,
    }
    # With robot_collision active, the LiDAR treats the other B-bots as
    # moving obstacles.
    config["lidar"]["enabled"] = True

    fleet = [
        {"id": 0, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [2.0, 2.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
        {"id": 1, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [5.0, 5.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
        {"id": 2, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [18.0, 2.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
        {"id": 3, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [18.0, 10.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
    ]

    exp = SwarmExperiment(
        robots=fleet,
        backend="navsim2d",
        config=config,
        orientation=True,
    )

    # Heterogeneous tuning: a bolder leader and more conservative followers
    exp.assign_agent(robot_id=0, agent_class=PatrolAgent, sep_gain=0.5, kp=0.45)
    exp.assign_agent(robot_ids=[1, 2, 3], agent_class=PatrolAgent, sep_gain=0.9)

    routes = {
        0: [(2, 2), (5, 2), (5, 6), (2, 6)],
        1: [(5, 5), (10, 5), (10, 9), (5, 9)],
        2: [(18, 2), (15, 2), (15, 6), (18, 6)],
        # B-bot 3 patrols the upper right. Its route must stay clear of B-bot 2:
        # two B-bots heading to the same (or nearly the same) point can never
        # both sit inside the goal tolerance without overlapping, so they would
        # deadlock against each other's separation term.
        3: [(18, 10), (14, 10), (14, 8), (18, 8)],
    }
    for index, points in routes.items():
        exp.assign_route(index, route_with_orientation(points))

    print(f"Decentralized swarm ready: {len(fleet)} agents. Keys 1..{len(fleet)} select a B-bot.")
    exp.run()

    # In the decentralized mode the DataLogger lives inside the engine's
    # Simulator, created by the navsim2d backend. Use the experiment helpers to
    # save/plot it after the run (pickle by default, CSV via `save_log("x.csv")`).
    exp.save_log("decentralized_swarm_log.pkl")
    exp.print_collisions()

See the OpenLab API for the full SwarmExperiment surface.

To spread the same fleet over several CPU cores with the engine's fleet_controller seam, see the Decentralized Swarm across CPU cores example.

docs.title: Decentralized Swarm across CPU cores
docs.text:
Reference: examples/decentralized_multiprocess.py

A variant of the Decentralized Swarm example where each B-bot's controller runs on a separate process, so the fleet is spread over several CPU cores.

docs.title: Why it works
docs.text: The engine computes every B-bot's command from a frozen snapshot of the fleet and only integrates the kinematics afterwards, so the per-agent control is independent. Python's GIL blocks CPU parallelism with threads, so this example maps the controllers over a concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor. The pygame window stays in the main process; only the controller math runs in the workers.

docs.title: What it shows
docs.text:
• The engine seam Simulator(..., fleet_controller=...).
  • Building one plain task per B-bot and mapping it over a process pool.
  • Passing only numbers (no engine objects) across process boundaries, so the tasks are picklable.
  • A local Kanayama controller with a directional separation term.

docs.title: Key parts
docs.text:
The engine calls the controller once per frame:

def parallel_fleet_controller(robots, goals, config, dt, lidar_readings=None):
    r_tol = float(config.get("waypoints", {}).get("goal_tolerance", 0.2))
    tasks = [...]                       # one plain tuple per B-bot
    commands = [{} for _ in robots]
    for index, v, w in pool.map(_worker, tasks):
        commands[index] = {"v": v, "omega": w}
    return commands

docs.title: Getting the waypoints right
docs.text:
Two details matter for the B-bots to reach every waypoint:

  1. Match the stop radius to the goal tolerance. compute_control stops when rho < r_tol. This value must equal the engine's waypoints.goal_tolerance (0.1 in config/default.yaml); otherwise the B-bot parks just outside the tolerance circle and the waypoint never advances. The controller reads it straight from the engine config.
  2. Keep the routes clear of each other. The separation term only brakes for neighbors that are ahead and adds a small steering bias, so crossing paths go around each other instead of stalling. Routes must still avoid two B-bots targeting the same point: they can never both sit inside the goal tolerance without overlapping, so they would deadlock.

docs.title: Run it
docs.text:
python examples/decentralized_multiprocess.py
python examples/decentralized_multiprocess.py --workers 4

The console prints the number of worker processes used. On Windows and macOS the pool uses the spawn start method, so the script keeps its work under if __name__ == "__main__": and hides the repeated pygame import banner with PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT.

docs.title: Full source
docs.text:
examples/decentralized_multiprocess.py
"""Decentralized swarm with each B-bot controlled on its own CPU core.

The ``navsim2d`` backend normally calls every agent sequentially in the main
process. Because the engine computes the whole fleet's commands from a *frozen
snapshot* and only then integrates the kinematics, the per-agent control is
independent and can be parallelised.

Python's GIL blocks CPU parallelism with threads, so this example spreads the
controllers over a process pool (``concurrent.futures.ProcessPoolExecutor``),
one worker per CPU core. The pygame window stays in the main process; only the
controller math runs in the workers.

Controls:
    Keys 1..N  -> select B-bot | Left click -> add waypoint | Right click -> obstacle
"""

import argparse
import math
import os
import sys
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
from pathlib import Path

# The worker processes re-import this module (spawn start method on Windows and
# macOS), so their pygame import would print its banner once per worker. Keep
# the console readable.
os.environ.setdefault("PYGAME_HIDE_SUPPORT_PROMPT", "1")

project_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.append(str(project_root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root / "src"))

from hivebr.engine import Simulator, load_config


def wrap(angle):
    return (angle + math.pi) % (2.0 * math.pi) - math.pi


def compute_control(sx, sy, stheta, goal, radius, max_speed, max_omega,
                    neighbors, r_tol=0.2, sep_gain=0.9, sep_steer=1.2,
                    sep_margin=0.35):
    """Pure-math Kanayama controller with local separation.

    This runs inside the worker processes, so it only receives plain numbers
    (no engine objects) and returns plain floats. ``r_tol`` must match the
    engine's ``waypoints.goal_tolerance`` (passed in by the caller), otherwise
    the B-bot stops short of the goal and the waypoint never advances.
    """
    if goal is None:
        return 0.0, 0.0

    gx, gy, gtheta = goal
    dx = gx - sx
    dy = gy - sy
    rho = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    if rho < r_tol:
        return 0.0, 0.0

    # Kanayama control in polar coordinates.
    kp, k_alpha, k_beta = 0.35, 1.5, -1.0
    alpha = wrap(math.atan2(dy, dx) - stheta)
    beta = wrap(gtheta - stheta - alpha)
    if abs(alpha) > math.pi / 2:
        alpha = wrap(alpha - math.pi)
        beta = wrap(beta - math.pi)
        kp = -kp

    v = kp * rho
    w = k_beta * beta + k_alpha * alpha

    # Reactive separation from the visible neighbors (also plain numbers).
    # The braking term only acts on neighbors that are *ahead* (in the forward
    # half-plane); braking on every neighbor makes two B-bots whose paths cross
    # cancel each other's forward speed and deadlock. A small steering term
    # biases the heading away from the neighbor so they go around instead.
    for nx, ny, nradius in neighbors:
        d = math.hypot(sx - nx, sy - ny)
        safe = radius + nradius + sep_margin
        if 0.0 < d < safe:
            shortfall = safe - d
            bearing = wrap(math.atan2(ny - sy, nx - sx) - stheta)
            v -= sep_gain * shortfall * max(0.0, math.cos(bearing))
            w -= sep_steer * shortfall * math.sin(bearing)

    v = max(-max_speed, min(max_speed, v))
    w = max(-max_omega, min(max_omega, w))
    return v, w


def _worker(task):
    """One task = one B-bot. Executed in a worker process."""
    (index, sx, sy, stheta, goal, radius, max_speed, max_omega, neighbors,
     r_tol) = task
    v, w = compute_control(sx, sy, stheta, goal, radius, max_speed, max_omega,
                           neighbors, r_tol)
    return index, v, w


def route_with_orientation(points):
    waypoints = []
    for p, p_next in zip(points, points[1:] + [points[0]]):
        theta = math.atan2(p_next[1] - p[1], p_next[0] - p[0])
        waypoints.append([p[0], p[1], theta])
    return waypoints


def make_parallel_fleet_controller(pool, comm_radius):
    """Build the engine ``fleet_controller`` that maps tasks over the pool."""

    def parallel_fleet_controller(robots, goals, config, dt, lidar_readings=None):
        """Engine seam: build one plain task per B-bot and map it over the pool."""
        # The stop radius has to match the engine's waypoint tolerance, so the
        # B-bot parks *inside* the tolerance circle and the waypoint advances.
        r_tol = float(config.get("waypoints", {}).get("goal_tolerance", 0.2))

        tasks = []
        for i, robot in enumerate(robots):
            goal = goals[i] if goals is not None else None
            if goal is not None:
                gtheta = float(goal[2]) if len(goal) > 2 else float(robot.theta)
                goal = (float(goal[0]), float(goal[1]), gtheta)

            # Visible neighbors: plain (x, y, radius) tuples, no engine objects.
            neighbors = []
            for j, other in enumerate(robots):
                if j == i:
                    continue
                if comm_radius is None or math.hypot(
                    robot.x - other.x, robot.y - other.y
                ) <= comm_radius:
                    neighbors.append((float(other.x), float(other.y), float(other.radius)))

            tasks.append((
                i, float(robot.x), float(robot.y), float(robot.theta), goal,
                float(robot.radius), float(robot.max_speed), float(robot.max_omega),
                neighbors, r_tol,
            ))

        commands = [{} for _ in robots]
        for index, v, w in pool.map(_worker, tasks):
            commands[index] = {"v": v, "omega": w}
        return commands

    return parallel_fleet_controller


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Decentralized swarm with one worker process per CPU core"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=os.cpu_count() or 1,
                        help="number of worker processes (default: all cores)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    config = load_config(project_root / "config" / "default.yaml")
    config["interaction"] = {
        "collision_policy": "resolve",
        "robot_collision": True,
        "robot_safety_margin": 0.0,
        "resolve_push": 0.05,
        "comm_radius": 3.0,
        "show_robot_links": True,
    }
    config["lidar"]["enabled"] = True

    config["robots"] = [
        {"id": 0, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [2.0, 2.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
        {"id": 1, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [5.0, 5.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
        {"id": 2, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [18.0, 2.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
        {"id": 3, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [18.0, 10.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
    ]

    routes = {
        0: [(2, 2), (5, 2), (5, 6), (2, 6)],
        1: [(5, 5), (10, 5), (10, 9), (5, 9)],
        2: [(18, 2), (15, 2), (15, 6), (18, 6)],
        # B-bot 3 patrols the upper right. Its route must stay clear of B-bot 2:
        # two B-bots heading to the same (or nearly the same) point can never
        # both sit inside the goal tolerance without overlapping, so they would
        # deadlock against each other's separation term.
        3: [(18, 10), (14, 10), (14, 8), (18, 8)],
    }

    comm_radius = config["interaction"]["comm_radius"]
    pool = ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=max(1, args.workers))
    controller = make_parallel_fleet_controller(pool, comm_radius)

    sim = Simulator(config=config, fleet_controller=controller)
    for index, points in routes.items():
        sim.set_robot_waypoints(index, route_with_orientation(points))
    sim.set_using_orientation(True)

    print(
        f"Decentralized swarm: {sim.num_robots} B-bots, "
        f"controllers mapped over {max(1, args.workers)} worker process(es)."
    )
    sim.run()
    pool.shutdown()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

See the OpenLab API for the agent-centric HiveBrAgent.loop(state, neighbors) alternative used by the single-process decentralized example.

docs.title: Single Robot — Hexagonal Holonomic (3-Wheel Omni)
docs.text:
Reference: examples/run_hexagonal_holonomic.py

A hexagonal holonomic robot with 3 omni-wheels at 120° (aligned with hexagon sides), controlled via inverse kinematics with control allocation to convert world-frame velocity commands into individual wheel speeds.

docs.title: What it shows
docs.text:
• The hexagonal_holonomic robot model with direct servo control
  • Inverse kinematics to convert (vx, vy, ω) → (ω₁, ω₂, ω₃)
  • Control allocation to respect servo speed limits
  • Waypoint navigation with orientation

docs.title: Kinematics
docs.text:
Wheel geometry: 3 omni-wheels at 60°, 180°, 300° (flat hexagon sides, distance \(L\) from center)

For an omni-wheel at angle \(\phi\), the tangent direction (force/velocity applied to ground) is perpendicular to the radius:

\[ \mathbf{t}(\phi) = \begin{bmatrix} -\sin\phi \\ \cos\phi \end{bmatrix} \] Wheel Position \(\phi\) Tangent angle \(\phi + 90^\circ\) Tangent vector \(\mathbf{t}\) 1 \(60^\circ\) \(150^\circ\) \(\begin{bmatrix} -\sin 60^\circ \\ \cos 60^\circ \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \\ \frac{1}{2} \end{bmatrix}\) 2 \(180^\circ\) \(270^\circ\) \(\begin{bmatrix} -\sin 180^\circ \\ \cos 180^\circ \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \\ -1 \end{bmatrix}\) 3 \(300^\circ\) \(30^\circ\) \(\begin{bmatrix} -\sin 300^\circ \\ \cos 300^\circ \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \\ \frac{1}{2} \end{bmatrix}\)

Forward kinematics (wheel speeds \(\omega_i\) → robot velocity):

\[ \begin{bmatrix} \dot{x} \\ \dot{y} \\ \dot{\theta} \end{bmatrix} = \underbrace{\begin{bmatrix} -r\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} & 0 & r\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2} \\[4pt] \frac{r}{2} & -r & \frac{r}{2} \\[4pt] \frac{r}{3L} & \frac{r}{3L} & \frac{r}{3L} \end{bmatrix}}_{\mathbf{J}_f} \begin{bmatrix} \omega_1 \\ \omega_2 \\ \omega_3 \end{bmatrix} \]

Inverse kinematics (robot velocity → wheel speeds):

\[ \begin{bmatrix} \omega_1 \\ \omega_2 \\ \omega_3 \end{bmatrix} = \mathbf{J}_f^{\dagger} \begin{bmatrix} \dot{x} \\ \dot{y} \\ \dot{\theta} \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} -\frac{2}{3r} & \frac{\sqrt{3}}{3r} & \frac{L}{r} \\[4pt] -\frac{2}{3r} & -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{3r} & \frac{L}{r} \\[4pt] \frac{4}{3r} & 0 & \frac{L}{r} \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} \dot{x} \\ \dot{y} \\ \dot{\theta} \end{bmatrix} \]

Where \(r\) = wheel radius, \(L\) = robot radius (center to wheel).

docs.title: Key Parts
docs.text:
def servo_controller(robot, world, goal, config, dt, lidar_readings):
    if goal is None:
        return {"omega1": 0.0, "omega2": 0.0, "omega3": 0.0}

    goal_pos = np.array(goal[:2])
    pos = robot.position
    to_goal = goal_pos - pos
    dist = np.linalg.norm(to_goal)

    tolerance = 0.15
    if dist < tolerance:
        return {"omega1": 0.0, "omega2": 0.0, "omega3": 0.0}

    # World-frame velocity control
    kv = 2.0
    vx_des = kv * to_goal[0]
    vy_des = kv * to_goal[1]

    # Limit linear speed
    speed = math.hypot(vx_des, vy_des)
    if speed > robot.max_speed:
        scale = robot.max_speed / speed
        vx_des *= scale
        vy_des *= scale

    # Angular velocity to align with goal
    goal_angle = math.atan2(to_goal[1], to_goal[0])
    angle_diff = (goal_angle - robot.theta + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    kw = 3.0
    omega_des = kw * angle_diff
    omega_des = max(-robot.max_omega, min(robot.max_omega, omega_des))

    # Control allocation: scale down until wheels fit within servo limits
    max_servo = robot.servo_max_speed

    for _ in range(5):
        omega1, omega2, omega3 = robot._inverse_kinematics(vx_des, vy_des, omega_des)
        max_wheel = max(abs(omega1), abs(omega2), abs(omega3))
        if max_wheel <= max_servo:
            break
        scale = max_servo / max_wheel
        vx_des *= scale
        vy_des *= scale
        omega_des *= scale

    # Final inverse kinematics
    omega1, omega2, omega3 = robot._inverse_kinematics(vx_des, vy_des, omega_des)

    # Final clamp
    omega1 = max(-max_servo, min(max_servo, omega1))
    omega2 = max(-max_servo, min(max_servo, omega2))
    omega3 = max(-max_servo, min(max_servo, omega3))

    return {"omega1": omega1, "omega2": omega2, "omega3": omega3}

docs.text:
examples/run_hexagonal_holonomic.py
"""
Example: Hexagonal Holonomic Robot (3 wheels at 120 degrees)

Direct servo control using inverse kinematics with control allocation.
Uses world-frame velocity (vx, vy) for goal tracking and omega for alignment,
then converts to wheel speeds (omega1, omega2, omega3) via inverse kinematics.

Kinematics:
    [ẋ]   [ -r/√3   0     r/√3  ] [ω1]
    [ẏ] = [  r/3   -2r/3   r/3  ] [ω2]
    [θ̇]   [ r/3L   r/3L   r/3L  ] [ω3]

Wheel geometry (matching kinematic matrix):
    Wheel 1: 60°  (right-upper side)  - tangent 150°
    Wheel 2: 180° (left side / back)  - tangent 270°
    Wheel 3: 300° (right-lower side)  - tangent 30°
"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys
import math
import numpy as np

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))

from hivebr.engine import Simulator, load_config


def servo_controller(robot, world, goal, config, dt, lidar_readings):
    """
    Direct servo control using inverse kinematics with control allocation.
    Uses world-frame velocity control (vx, vy) for natural goal tracking,
    then converts to wheel speeds (omega1, omega2, omega3) via inverse kinematics.
    Implements control allocation to handle wheel saturation.
    """
    if goal is None:
        return {"omega1": 0.0, "omega2": 0.0, "omega3": 0.0}

    # Goal position
    goal_pos = np.array(goal[:2])
    pos = robot.position
    to_goal = goal_pos - pos
    dist = np.linalg.norm(to_goal)

    # Goal tolerance
    tolerance = 0.15
    if dist < tolerance:
        return {"omega1": 0.0, "omega2": 0.0, "omega3": 0.0}

    # World-frame velocity control (proportional to position error)
    kv = 2.0
    vx_des = kv * to_goal[0]
    vy_des = kv * to_goal[1]

    # Limit linear speed
    speed = math.hypot(vx_des, vy_des)
    if speed > robot.max_speed:
        scale = robot.max_speed / speed
        vx_des *= scale
        vy_des *= scale

    # Angular velocity to align with goal direction
    goal_angle = math.atan2(to_goal[1], to_goal[0])
    angle_diff = (goal_angle - robot.theta + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    kw = 3.0
    omega_des = kw * angle_diff
    omega_des = max(-robot.max_omega, min(robot.max_omega, omega_des))

    # Control allocation: scale down (vx, vy, omega) until wheels fit within limits
    max_servo = robot.servo_max_speed

    for _ in range(5):
        omega1, omega2, omega3 = robot._inverse_kinematics(vx_des, vy_des, omega_des)
        max_wheel = max(abs(omega1), abs(omega2), abs(omega3))
        if max_wheel <= max_servo:
            break
        scale = max_servo / max_wheel
        vx_des *= scale
        vy_des *= scale
        omega_des *= scale

    # Final inverse kinematics
    omega1, omega2, omega3 = robot._inverse_kinematics(vx_des, vy_des, omega_des)

    # Final clamp
    omega1 = max(-max_servo, min(max_servo, omega1))
    omega2 = max(-max_servo, min(max_servo, omega2))
    omega3 = max(-max_servo, min(max_servo, omega3))

    return {"omega1": omega1, "omega2": omega2, "omega3": omega3}


def draw_info(sim, screen):
    """Draw robot state info on screen."""
    import pygame
    font = pygame.font.SysFont("consolas", 14)
    robot = sim.robot

    lines = [
        "Hexagonal Holonomic Robot - Servo Control",
        "",
        f"Pos:  x={robot.x:6.2f}  y={robot.y:6.2f}  th={robot.theta:6.2f}",
        f"Vel:  vx={robot.vx:6.2f}  vy={robot.vy:6.2f}  w={robot.omega:6.2f}",
        f"Servo: w1={robot.omega1:6.2f}  w2={robot.omega2:6.2f}  w3={robot.omega3:6.2f} rad/s",
        "",
        f"Goal: {sim.waypoints.get_current_waypoint()}",
        f"Waypoint: {sim.waypoints.current_index + 1}/{len(sim.waypoints.waypoints)}",
        "",
        "SPACE - Pause/Resume",
        "Click - Set waypoint",
    ]

    y = 20
    for line in lines:
        surf = font.render(line, True, (255, 255, 255))
        screen.blit(surf, (20, y))
        y += 20


if __name__ == "__main__":
    config = load_config(ROOT / "config" / "hexagonal_holonomic.yaml")

    sim = Simulator(config=config, controller=servo_controller, draw_callback=None)
    sim.running_simulation = sim.config.get("running_simulation", False)

    print("=" * 50)
    print("Hexagonal Holonomic Robot - Servo Control Demo")
    print("=" * 50)
    print("Controller: Direct wheel speeds (omega1, omega2, omega3)")
    print("Using inverse kinematics + control allocation")
    print("SPACE - Pause/Resume | Click - Set waypoint")
    print("=" * 50)

    sim.run()

docs.title: Full source
docs.text:
examples/multi_line_follower.py
"""Vários robôs seguidores de linha na MESMA pista, iniciando no MESMO ponto.

Cada B-bot usa um conjunto de ganhos PID diferente, o que permite comparar
o desempenho (tempo por volta, tempo total, número de voltas) de estratégias
de sintonia distintas sob condições idênticas.

Como todos os robôs partem exatamente do mesmo ponto, a colisão robô-robô é
desativada através de::

    config["interaction"] = {
        "collision_policy": "none",   # ou robot_collision: False
        "robot_collision": False,
    }

O tempo de cada robô aparece no painel de informações. Use o botão
"Toggle Times" (ou ``config["show_times"]``) para desabilitar essa
visualização.

Controles padrão do simulador:
    Espaço (botão Start) -> inicia/pausa a simulação
    Botão do meio        -> arrastar (pan) | roda do mouse -> zoom
    Botão Toggle Times   -> mostra/esconde o tempo por robô

Referência de geração de pista: ``examples/line_follower.py``.
"""

import argparse
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

project_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.append(str(project_root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root / "src"))

from hivebr.engine import Simulator, load_config
from hivebr.engine.geometry import clamp

from line_follower import (
    generate_random_track,
    pose_on_track,
)

TRACK_PATH = project_root / "config" / "line_track.png"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Conjuntos de ganhos PID avaliados (um por robô)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
GAIN_SETS = [
    {"base_speed": 0.30, "kp": 3.0, "ki": 0.00, "kd": 0.6, "integral_limit": 1.0},
    {"base_speed": 0.30, "kp": 10.0, "ki": 0.00, "kd": 0.0, "integral_limit": 1.0},
    {"base_speed": 0.30, "kp": 6.0, "ki": 0.00, "kd": 0.0, "integral_limit": 1.0},
    {"base_speed": 0.30, "kp": 28.0, "ki": 0.20, "kd": 1.6, "integral_limit": 1.0},
]

# Estado do termo integral por robô (chave = id(robot)).
_CTRL_STATE: dict[int, dict] = {}


def line_pid_controller(robot, world, goal, cfg, dt, lidar_readings=None):
    """PID de seguimento de linha com ganhos POR ROBÔ.

    Os ganhos vêm de ``robot.pid_params`` (definido no ``main``). Se ausente,
    usa o bloco ``line_pid`` da configuração global.
    """
    line_map = getattr(world, "line_map", None)
    if line_map is None or not hasattr(robot, "read_line_sensors"):
        return {"v": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}

    robot.read_line_sensors(line_map)
    error = robot.line_error

    pid = getattr(robot, "pid_params", None) or cfg.get("line_pid", {})
    base_speed = float(pid.get("base_speed", 0.35))
    kp = float(pid.get("kp", 3.0))
    ki = float(pid.get("ki", 0.0))
    kd = float(pid.get("kd", 0.8))
    integral_limit = float(pid.get("integral_limit", 1.0))

    state = _CTRL_STATE.setdefault(id(robot), {"integral": 0.0, "prev": 0.0})

    if robot.line_lost:
        state["integral"] = 0.0
        omega = 1.5 * (1.0 if error >= 0.0 else -1.0)
        velocity = base_speed * 0.4
    else:
        state["integral"] = clamp(
            state["integral"] + error * dt, -integral_limit, integral_limit
        )
        derivative = (error - state["prev"]) / dt if dt > 0.0 else 0.0
        omega = kp * error + ki * state["integral"] + kd * derivative
        velocity = base_speed * max(0.15, 1.0 - 0.6 * abs(error))

    state["prev"] = error

    velocity = clamp(velocity, 0.0, robot.max_speed)
    omega = clamp(omega, -robot.max_omega, robot.max_omega)
    return {"v": velocity, "omega": omega}


def resolve_gains(num_robots: int):
    """Repete/corta a lista de ganhos para o número de robôs pedido."""
    if num_robots <= len(GAIN_SETS):
        return GAIN_SETS[:num_robots]
    gains = []
    while len(gains) < num_robots:
        gains.append(GAIN_SETS[len(gains) % len(GAIN_SETS)])
    return gains


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        description="Multi line follower: mesma pista, mesmo ponto, ganhos diferentes"
    )
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=7, help="semente da trajetória")
    parser.add_argument("--sensors", type=int, default=None, help="nº de sensores (2, 5 ou 8)")
    parser.add_argument("--robots", type=int, default=len(GAIN_SETS), help="número de robôs")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--spread",
        type=float,
        default=0.0,
        help="deslocamento lateral (m) entre robôs; 0 = todos no mesmo ponto",
    )
    parser.add_argument("--regenerate", action="store_true", help="força nova trajetória")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    num_robots = max(1, int(args.robots))
    gains = resolve_gains(num_robots)

    config = load_config(project_root / "config" / "line_follower.yaml")
    if args.sensors is not None:
        config["robot"]["num_sensors"] = int(args.sensors)

    if args.regenerate or not TRACK_PATH.exists():
        print(f"Gerando trajetória aleatória (seed={args.seed}) -> {TRACK_PATH}")
    points = generate_random_track(TRACK_PATH, seed=args.seed)
    config["world"]["line_map_image"] = str(TRACK_PATH)

    # Todos os robôs partem do MESMO ponto/tangente da pista.
    x0, y0, theta0 = pose_on_track(points)
    config["robots"] = [
        {
            "id": i,
            "type": "line_follower",
            "initial_pose": [x0, y0, theta0],
            "radius": float(config["robot"].get("radius", 0.05)),
        }
        for i in range(num_robots)
    ]

    # Não avaliar colisão entre os robôs (eles começam sobrepostos).
    config["interaction"] = {
        "collision_policy": "none",
        "robot_collision": False,
        "robot_safety_margin": 0.0,
        "resolve_push": 0.0,
        "comm_radius": None,
        "show_robot_links": False,
    }

    # Visualização do tempo por robô (botão "Toggle Times" no painel).
    config["show_times"] = True

    sim = Simulator(config=config, controller=line_pid_controller)

    # Associa os ganhos a cada robô e, opcionalmente, aplica um leve
    # deslocamento lateral para facilitar a visualização das trajetórias.
    lateral = np.array([-math.sin(theta0), math.cos(theta0)])
    for i, robot in enumerate(sim.robots):
        robot.pid_params = dict(gains[i])
        if args.spread > 0.0:
            offset = (i - (num_robots - 1) / 2.0) * args.spread
            robot.set_initial_pose(x0 + lateral[0] * offset, y0 + lateral[1] * offset, theta0)

    sim.camera.initial_zoom = 1.0
    sim.camera.reset()

    print(
        f"{num_robots} robôs seguidores de linha | {sim.robots[0].num_sensors} sensores | "
        f"ponto inicial=({x0:.2f}, {y0:.2f}, {math.degrees(theta0):.1f}°) | "
        f"colisão robô-robô: DESATIVADA"
    )
    for i, g in enumerate(gains):
        print(
            f"  B-Bot{i}: kp={g['kp']:.2f}, ki={g['ki']:.2f}, kd={g['kd']:.2f}, "
            f"v0={g['base_speed']:.2f}"
        )
    print("Clique em Start (ou pressione Espaço) para iniciar.")

    sim.run()

    print("\n===== Resultado por robô =====")
    for i, robot in enumerate(sim.robots):
        g = gains[i]
        stats = robot.lap_statistics()
        tag = f"B-Bot{i} (kp={g['kp']:.2f}, ki={g['ki']:.2f}, kd={g['kd']:.2f})"
        if stats["count"]:
            print(
                f"{tag}: {stats['count']} volta(s) | média={stats['mean']:.2f}s | "
                f"melhor={stats['best']:.2f}s | pior={stats['worst']:.2f}s"
            )
        elif getattr(robot, "finished", False):
            print(f"{tag}: percurso concluído em {robot.finish_time:.2f}s.")
        else:
            print(f"{tag}: encerrado em {robot.time:.2f}s sem voltas completas.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

See Robot Models for the line-follower configuration and Multi-Robot Fleets for the collision flag.

Reference: examples/multi_robot_differential.py

The multi-robot counterpart of the single B-bot example. A single controller callable is called once per B-bot, each with its own goal and LiDAR scan. The engine integrates all B-bots from a frozen snapshot.

docs.title: What it shows
docs.text:
• A robots list in the configuration (fleet definition).
  • One route per B-bot via set_robot_waypoints.
  • Per-robot fleet colors from the fleet palette.
  • The robot-robot interaction policy (collision_policy + robot_collision).
  • The LiDAR treating the other B-bots as moving obstacles (lidar.enabled: true).
  • The multi-line HUD and 1…N B-bot selection.

examples/multi_robot_differential.py
"""Multi-robot differential-drive navigation.

Mirrors ``controle_robodiferencial.py`` (single B-bot, Kanayama controller) but
drives a fleet: every B-bot gets its own color, waypoint route and battery.
The same per-robot controller is called once per B-bot each step, and the
engine integrates all robots from a frozen snapshot (order independent).

Controls:
    Left click  -> add waypoint to the selected B-bot
    Right click -> add obstacle
    Keys 1..9   -> select B-bot
    Middle drag -> pan | mouse wheel -> zoom
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np

project_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
sys.path.append(str(project_root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root))
sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root / "src"))

from hivebr.engine import Simulator, load_config


def normalize_angle(angle):
    return np.arctan2(np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle))


def full_controller(robot, world, goal, cfg, dt, lidar_readings=None, r_tol=None):
    """Non-holonomic position+orientation controller (Kanayama, 1990).

    Identical in spirit to the single-robot example, but receives the B-bot,
    its own goal and its own LiDAR readings because the engine dispatches one
    call per robot.
    """
    if r_tol is None:
        r_tol = float(cfg.get("waypoints", {}).get("goal_tolerance", 0.2))

    if goal is None:
        return {"v": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}

    xd, yd, theta_d = goal[0], goal[1], goal[2]
    x, y, theta = robot.position[0], robot.position[1], robot.theta

    if np.isnan(theta_d):
        theta_d = theta

    # 1. Control params
    kp = 3.5 / 10
    k_alpha = 15 / 10
    k_beta = -10 / 10

    # 2. Polar transform
    delta_x = xd - x
    delta_y = yd - y
    rho = np.linalg.norm([delta_x, delta_y])
    alpha = normalize_angle(np.arctan2(delta_y, delta_x) - theta)
    beta = normalize_angle(theta_d - theta - alpha)

    # Stop when the target is reached
    if rho < r_tol:
        return {"v": 0.0, "omega": 0.0}

    # 3. Control action
    if np.abs(alpha) > np.pi / 2:
        alpha = normalize_angle(alpha - np.pi)
        beta = normalize_angle(beta - np.pi)
        kp = -kp

    v = kp * rho
    w = k_beta * beta + k_alpha * alpha

    # 4. Safety saturation
    v = max(min(v, robot.max_speed), -robot.max_speed)
    w = max(min(w, robot.max_omega), -robot.max_omega)

    return {"v": v, "omega": w}


def route_with_orientation(points):
    """Turn a closed list of (x, y) into (x, y, theta) waypoints."""
    waypoints = []
    for p, p_next in zip(points, points[1:] + [points[0]]):
        theta = np.arctan2(p_next[1] - p[1], p_next[0] - p[0])
        waypoints.append(np.array([p[0], p[1], theta]))
    return waypoints


if __name__ == "__main__":
    config = load_config(project_root / "config" / "default.yaml")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Fleet definition: each entry overrides the default robot config
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    config["robots"] = [
        {"id": 0, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [2.0, 2.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
        {"id": 1, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [5.0, 5.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
        {"id": 2, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [18.0, 2.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
        {"id": 3, "type": "differential", "initial_pose": [18.0, 10.0, 0.0], "radius": 0.25},
    ]

    # Robot-robot interaction policy
    config["interaction"] = {
        "collision_policy": "stop",
        "robot_collision": True,
        "robot_safety_margin": 0.0,
        "resolve_push": 0.05,
        "comm_radius": None,
        "show_robot_links": True,
    }

    # With robot_collision active, the LiDAR treats the other B-bots as
    # moving obstacles (only visible when the sensor is enabled).
    config["lidar"]["enabled"] = True

    sim = Simulator(config=config, controller=full_controller)

    sim.set_using_orientation(True)
    # Goal tolerance comes from config/default.yaml (`waypoints.goal_tolerance`).

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # One patrol route per B-bot
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    routes = {
        0: [(2, 2), (5, 2), (5, 6), (2, 6)],
        1: [(5, 5), (10, 5), (10, 9), (5, 9)],
        2: [(18, 2), (15, 2), (15, 6), (18, 6)],
        3: [(18, 10), (14, 10), (14, 6), (18, 6)],
    }
    for index, points in routes.items():
        sim.set_robot_waypoints(index, route_with_orientation(points))

    # Battery model (optional per robot)
    for robot in sim.robots:
        robot.set_battery_parameters(c_idle=0.1, c_v=4.0, c_w=1.0, critical_battery=50, working_battery=90)

    serial = 0
    for rp in [[3, 3], [5, 5], [9, 9], [16, 3], [16, 9]]:
        sim.world.recharge_places.append(np.array([rp[0], rp[1], 0.0]))

    print(f"Fleet ready: {sim.num_robots} B-bots. Keys 1..{sim.num_robots} select a robot.")
    sim.run()

See Multi-Robot Fleets for the interaction model and the deterministic stepping guarantees.

Reference: examples/controle_robodiferencial.py

A single differential B-bot driven by a Kanayama (1990) position-and-heading controller in polar coordinates. This is the canonical low-level example: a plain callable controller plus the interactive engine.

docs.title: What it shows
docs.text:
• The controller interface (robot, world, goal, config, dt, lidar_readings).
  • A differential B-bot with a battery model and a recharge routine.
  • Setting a route directly on the waypoint manager.
  • Orientation control and a goal tolerance.

    ...

The controller receives the current goal (a waypoint [x, y, theta]) for the B-bot it is called with, so the same function can later be reused per robot in a fleet.

import sys
import os
from pathlib import Path
# Add project root to sys.path
project_root = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent

import time

import numpy as np
from hivebr.engine import Simulator, load_config, DataLogger

def normalize_angle(angle):
    """Normalize an angle to the range [-pi, pi]."""
    return np.arctan2(np.sin(angle), np.cos(angle))


def full_controller(robot,world,goal,cfg,dt,lidar_readings=None, r_tol = None ):

    if r_tol is None:
        r_tol = float(cfg.get("waypoints", {}).get("goal_tolerance", 0.2))

    if goal is None:
        return {
            "v": 0.0,
            "omega": 0.0
        }
    """
    Non-holonomic controller (position and orientation), considering transformation to polar coordinates Kanayama (1990).
    """

    # waypoint atual (alvo)    
    xd, yd, theta_d = goal[0], goal[1], goal[2]

    # Configuração atual do robô
    x, y, theta = robot.position[0], robot.position[1], robot.theta

    #### Verifica recarga
    p = np.array([x,y])
    id_recharge = 0    
    p_recharge = np.array(sim.world.recharge_places[id_recharge])
    dist_recharge_place = np.linalg.norm(p -p_recharge)
    # print(f"{robot.battery_percent} < {robot.critical_battery},{robot.going_to_recharge}, {robot.is_charging}")

    if dist_recharge_place <= r_tol and robot.battery_percent < robot.critical_battery and robot.going_to_recharge :
        print("Recharge")
        robot.set_charging()

    elif robot.is_charging:
        # robot.going_to_recharge = False
        # print("Recharging")
        # robot.update_battery(dt, charge_rate=20.0)
        # time.sleep(0.1)
        return {
            "v": 0.0,
            "omega": 0.0
        }
    elif robot.battery_percent <= robot.critical_battery and not robot.going_to_recharge:
        sim.go_to_recharge_place(id=id_recharge)
        print("Going to recharge.")

    # 1. Parâmetros de Controle
    kp = 3.5/10       # Ganho de posição
    k_alpha = 15/10  # Ganho de orientação para o alvo
    k_beta = -10 /10  # Ganho de orientação para o alinhamento final


    # 2. Transformação para coordenadas polares
    delta_x = xd - x
    delta_y = yd - y

    rho = np.linalg.norm([delta_x, delta_y]) # Distância ao alvo
    alpha = np.arctan2(delta_y, delta_x) - theta  # Ângulo para o alvo
    beta = theta_d - theta - alpha  # Ângulo para o alinhamento final

    alpha = normalize_angle(alpha)
    beta  = normalize_angle(beta)

    # Stop
    if (rho < r_tol):# and (np.abs(theta_d - theta) < np.deg2rad(5)):  # If close enough and aligned
        # print(f"Target reached! {rho:.4f} m away, {np.rad2deg(theta_d - theta):.2f}° angular difference.")
        # print(f"Current position: ({x:.4f}, {y:.4f}), Current orientation: {np.rad2deg(theta):.2f}°")
        return {
            "v": 0.0,
            "omega": 0.0
        }

    # 3. Ação de controle
    if np.abs(alpha) > np.pi/2 :
        # If target is behind, invert direction
        alpha = normalize_angle(alpha-np.pi)
        beta = normalize_angle(beta-np.pi)
        kp = -kp  # Invert gain to move backwards

    v = kp * rho  # Linear velocity proportional to distance 
    w = k_beta * beta + k_alpha * alpha  # Angular velocity combining alignment and orientation


    # 5. Saturação (Segurança Física)
    v_max = robot.max_speed  # m/s
    w_max = robot.max_omega  # rad/s
    v = max(min(v, v_max), -v_max)
    w = max(min(w, w_max), -w_max)


    return {
            "v": v,
            "omega": w
        }

def simple_controller(robot,world,goal,cfg,dt,lidar_readings=None):

    if goal is None:
        return {
            "v": 0.0,
            "omega": 0.0
        }
    """
    Non-holonomic controller based on position error (De Luca & Oriolo).
    """

    # waypoint atual (alvo)
    current_target = goal
    xd, yd = current_target[0], current_target[1]

    # Estado atual do robô
    x, y, theta = robot.position[0], robot.position[1], robot.theta

    # 1. Parâmetros de Controle (Sintonia)
    kp = 1.5       # Ganho de translação
    k_theta = 3.0  # Ganho de rotação
    r_tol = float(cfg.get("waypoints", {}).get("goal_tolerance", 0.1))  # Tolerância (config)

    # 2. Dinâmica do Erro Posicional
    ex = xd - x
    ey = yd - y
    dist = np.linalg.norm([ex, ey])

    # Stop
    if dist < r_tol:
        return {
            "v": 0.0,
            "omega": 0.0
        }

    # 3. Encontro de Controle (u1 e u2)
    # De Luca & Oriolo propõem:     
    # u1 = kp * (ex * cos(theta) + ey * sin(theta))
    # u2 = k_theta * (atan2(ey, ex) - theta)
    v = kp * (ex * np.cos(theta) + ey * np.sin(theta))

    target_angle = np.arctan2(ey, ex)
    angle_error = target_angle - theta
    angle_error = np.arctan2(np.sin(angle_error), np.cos(angle_error))  # Normaliza para [-pi, pi]
    w = k_theta * angle_error

    # 5. Saturação (Segurança Física)
    v_max = robot.max_speed  # m/s
    w_max = robot.max_omega  # rad/s
    v = max(min(v, v_max), -v_max)
    w = max(min(w, w_max), -w_max)

    # Returns (v, w) for the kinematic model of the simulator
    return {
            "v": v,
            "omega": w
        }


if __name__ == "__main__":

    # logger = DataLogger()

    config = load_config(project_root / "config" / "default.yaml")
    sim = Simulator(config=config, controller=full_controller)

    sim.set_using_orientation(True)  # Enable orientation control
    # Goal tolerance comes from config/default.yaml (`waypoints.goal_tolerance`).
    sim.robot.radius = 0.3
    # points = np.array([[13.78774011, 17.80954127],
    #    [11.40046318, 18.29715419],
    #    [10.74931352, 19.70334332],
    #    [ 8.66268298, 18.35323118],
    #    [ 5.80521278, 15.16896191],
    #    [ 6.37229174, 13.98530471],

    #    [ 3.97591282, 16.10761446],
    #    [ 4.2854486 , 17.32823795],
    #    [ 2.0114067 , 18.0083447 ],
    #    [ 0.86470512, 16.92614813],
    #    [ 0.84455451, 15.96763401],
    #    [ 0.47053438, 14.40592448],
    #    [ 4.23390592,  9.78923973],
    #    [ 5.24030901,  9.6520633 ],
    #    [ 6.16529342,  8.88084524],
    #    [ 8.13144625,  5.41311853],
    #    [ 6.99132212,  3.1958151 ],
    #    [ 6.07119843,  4.89408015],
    #    [ 4.24605402,  5.88546147],
    #    [ 0.36549214,  3.7107074 ],
    #    [ 0.24620752,  1.51130259],
    #    [ 8.71977192,  0.82459723],
    #    [11.47940976,  4.07407243],
    #    [13.38134013,  2.769291  ],
    #    [14.91013307,  6.51265064],
    #    [14.07989192,  5.72117444],
    #    [12.84897326,  7.60983658],
    #    [10.1844024 , 13.86136469],
    #    [11.31499598, 12.34257273],
    #    [13.29919254, 13.84672586],
    #    [13.7653074 , 13.14225301],
    #    [15.92293081, 10.55072134],
    #    [16.174035  ,  7.36000639],
    #    [16.14470896,  6.52164136],
    #    [19.85282756,  5.27662509],
    #    [19.95213895, 11.99954731],
    #    [16.96269257, 14.14697128],
    #    [16.88791677, 17.02181214],
    #    [13.78774011, 17.80954127]])

    points = np.array([[5,7],
       [8,1], [0,0], [6, 5], [9, 1]])
    points_o = []
    for p, p1 in zip(points, points[1:]):
        theta = np.arctan2(p1[1]-p[1], p1[0]-p[0])
        pi = np.array([p[0], p[1], theta])
        points_o.append(pi)
    points_o = np.array(points_o)
    # print(points_o)

    sim.robot.set_battery_parameters(c_idle=0.1, c_v=4.0, c_w=1.0, critical_battery=50, working_battery=90)

    list_recharge_places = [[3, 3], [5,5], [9,9]]
    for rp in list_recharge_places:
